documents.title: Miller County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 183 pages. Amounts are the Schedule 2 printed totals per office: 'Operation Total', 'Salary Total', 'DEPARTMENT TOTAL'/'FUND TOTAL' (single 2026 amount per line); County General total from p. 56 column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
